lines.say: Your wedding ring just got cancelled. In front of everyone.
You rented it. Everyone does now. Ninety dollars a month.
She says I do. Then your phone buzzes.
The ring locks. It starts to flash red.
Two hundred guests watch it happen.
She tries to take it off. It won't come off.
Across the city, a million rings belong to one tower.
Would you still say yes? Write it in the comments.
